profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: All my life, I've had a passion for art. Curious to know more, I taught myself how to use programs such as Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro. My career pivoted into Sales for the Payment Processing Industry, where I created interpersonal relationships and developed a strong foundation for team building. My ability for problem solving and adapting to new situations has led me to becoming a team lead, managing a team of sales representatives. Even through this achievement, I desired something more challenging. After discovering programming, I was fascinated that I could continue to create and taught myself basic coding. That spark to learn more led me to enroll in Tech Elevator's 14 week Java boot camp in hopes of creating impactful applications. Upon graduation, I am looking for a junior developer role that will allow me to improve my coding skills and make more efficient software.

positions.title: Client Order Coordinator
positions.description:
- Coordinated end-to-end fulfillment of client orders, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and on-time delivery across multiple jurisdictions.
- Partnered with internal teams to manage order workflows and meet service-level agreements (SLAs).
- Reviewed and validated client documentation to ensure completeness, regulatory compliance, and adherence to internal quality standards.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Led the collaborative effort to revamp the Miviva product from Vue 2 to Vue 3, improving performance and enhancing user experience.
- Successfully refactored legacy codebase on Sage HRMS, implementing modern coding practices and improving maintainability.
- Played a pivotal role in the development, debugging, and testing of software applications across various projects, ensuring robustness and reliability.
- Tools/Tech used: JavaScript, Vue.js , Nuxt.js, jQuery, Node.js, Spring Boot, Junit, Postman, Git, Docker, npm, JSON, Jira

positions.title: Java Software Developer Student
positions.description:
Meal Planner
- Worked in Agile environment to create a meal planner web app using Java, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, Spring, and Vue.js. A user is able to log in, create their own list of recipes, create their own meal plan, and drag and drop their desired recipes into a meal. A meal plan consists of meals for each day of the week. Users can also retrieve a grocery list of the ingredients and exact measurements for the meal plan. Lastly, recipes are editable so that ingredients can be added/removed, name, description, and directions can be changed.

Tenmo Online Payment Service
- Developed a command line application and RESTful API server that functioned as an online payment service that allows money transfers between users.

Excelsior Venue
- Designed a venue reservation application utilizing Java and PostgreSQL that reads and writes from a database, displays venue details based on a user’s search criteria, allows for spaces to be reserved, and prints out an order confirmation.

Catering System
- Collaborated in pair programming and developed a catering system application using Java. The system is able to read the log file containing a list of inventory, allows a user to add money, place items in a shopping cart, complete orders, and prints a transaction report.

positions.title: Merchant Services Team Lead
positions.description:
- Expanded client base from 50 to 250+ accounts by implementing new sales strategy
- Increased monthly revenue from $10,000/mo to $40,000/mo by retaining customers and building loyalty
- Track and report KPIs on monthly revenue using Excel and SQL
- Organized training operation for 20+ employees and presented training deck using PowerPoint
- Analyze client’s merchant services statements to negotiate pricing and offer best solution

positions.title: Media Chair/Graphic Designer
positions.description:
- Communication liaison for executive members
- Designed all organization’s flyers, posters, and clothing materials using Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator
- Networked extensively with other AAA organizations nationwide across multiple university chapters

Brotherhood/Alumni Relations (09/15 - 11/15)
